description: This PHP source file defines the 'EmployeeWorkShiftAPI' class, an API endpoint providing access to employee work shift data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving a single employee's work shift by employee number, leverages traits and external models, and specifies validation rules for the parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShiftAPI
classes.description: A class that provides API endpoints for retrieving employee work shift data, extending the Endpoint class and implementing the ResourceEndpoint interface, using traits and external models for functionality.
